title: Page 148
transc:
R. R McCaine  Washn Aug 10th 1864 11. AM
Growl Aug Federal Fanny For Nabob
Shelton Augur has shown me your
telegram about Shelby Gmers Polka Zebra
It was directed by John that
this Pontiac Garrison Grapes till other
whisky could be sent here for
that purpose youth Indian very warm


S. H. Beckwith  Washn Aug 11th 1864 11 AM
Hang Hawkins Moses Fanny For Magic Tulip I have
Issued the report to Luther Pike but as he
sent Austin Dwight Caldwell Snyder Summer with Shark Bimey
Pike and as his Salem is much diminished by
sickness at this season Pike I very much doubt
if he can safely spare many Pike if any
more yacht I had previously Whimpered to Oyster to
send every thing he could possibly spare to Flora
yard Instead of there being any thing Optic Shylock
World Pike I yesterday repeated Caldwell Webbs from here
and Bard to Saddle Samples of war at Javas
Spafford Pike Chicago Pike Damon and Rock Spafford in
place of Davis Libels Summer about Toby discharged yacht
Gardner Webbs in Walker Bermuda are to be discharged
in Andrew or Caldwell Libels pause also most Talbot
Militia him and in Baron yard We have no
means of replacing them yawl lamb sticky mather this
